say:1:1521345001:0.text: Honestly... I thought I was done for.
say:1:1521345001:0.source_cn: 真不敢相信……我居然活下来了。

say:2:1521345002:0.text: If you hadn't pushed me to accept treatment, I'd be dead by now.
say:2:1521345002:0.source_cn: 要不是你劝我接受治疗，恐怕现在我已经是一具尸体了。
say:2:1521345002:0.male: If you hadn't pushed me to accept treatment, I'd be dead by now.
say:2:1521345002:0.female: If you hadn't pushed me to accept treatment, I'd be dead by now.

choice_prompt:3:1521345002.male: If you hadn't pushed me to accept treatment, I'd be dead by now.
choice_prompt:3:1521345002.female: If you hadn't pushed me to accept treatment, I'd be dead by now.

say:4:1521345003:0.text: Yeah, the medic saved my life. But it was your news about Fufu that kept me going.
say:4:1521345003:0.source_cn: 是军医救了我的命，但是你给我带来了芙的消息，我才能撑下去……
say:4:1521345003:0.male: Yeah, the medic saved my life. But it was your news about Fufu that kept me going.
say:4:1521345003:0.female: Yeah, the medic saved my life. But it was your news about Fufu that kept me going.

say:5:1521345005:0.text: How's Fufu doing in Wrathwood Grove? Last I heard, she had a big fight with her father...
say:5:1521345005:0.source_cn: 芙……她在树怒山谷怎么样？上次你们说，她和她阿爹吵架了……

say:7:1521345006:0.text: She's still worried about you. But her parents won't let her visit.
say:7:1521345006:0.source_cn: 她一直在为你担心，但她的阿爹阿娘不许她过来找你。

say:8:1521345007:0.text: Figured as much... From what Twitch said, it was clear her family would never approve...
say:8:1521345007:0.source_cn: 果然……从扭耳的态度就能看出来，她的家人不会同意……

choice_prompt:9:1521345007.text: Figured as much... From what Twitch said, it was clear her family would never approve...
choice_prompt:9:1521345007.source_cn: 果然……从扭耳的态度就能看出来，她的家人不会同意……

say:11:1521345009:0.text: And with my injuries, the doctor said I'll <style="highlight">probably never fight again</style>...
say:11:1521345009:0.source_cn: 而且，军医说以我现在的伤势，<style=highli...

say:12:1521345010:0.text: I'm not worthy of someone like Fufu anymore...
say:12:1521345010:0.source_cn: 这样的我根本配不上芙……

say:13:1521345011:0.text: You don't need to fight anymore. The war is over.
say:13:1521345011:0.source_cn: 战争已经结束，你不用再战斗。

say:14:1521345012:0.text: It's not the war I'm worried about... it's strength. I'm not like the Wildborn. We're built different.
say:14:1521345012:0.source_cn: 不，我在意的不是战争……是力量。我和雅库伯尔人之间的力...

say:15:1521345013:0.text: They're powerful, fierce, like wild animals... I can't compete with that. I don't fit their idea of what strength is...
say:15:1521345013:0.source_cn: 他们那么强大，有着野兽般的力量……我没办法与他们相较，...

say:16:1521345014:0.text: Even if I get to see her again, even if we could be together... how do I know she won't end up disappointed in me?
say:16:1521345014:0.source_cn: 哪怕能够再见，哪怕能在一起……谁又能保证芙永远不会对我失望？

say:17:1521345015:0.text: I... I don't want her to see me like this!
say:17:1521345015:0.source_cn: 我……我真的不想让她看到我这副样子！

choice_prompt:18:1521345015.text: I... I don't want her to see me like this!
choice_prompt:18:1521345015.source_cn: 我……我真的不想让她看到我这副样子！

choice:18:0:1.text: If you love her, fight for her.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 既然爱她，就该努力争取
choice:18:0:1.male: If you love her, fight for her.
choice:18:0:1.female: If you love her, fight for her.

choice:9:0:1.text: Your turn to fight for her now!
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 现在轮到你为她努力了！
choice:9:0:1.male: Your turn to fight for her now!
choice:9:0:1.female: Your turn to fight for her now!

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 她来不了，但你可以去找她

say:20:1521345004:0.text: You're right. If I hadn't heard about Fufu, I don't think I'd have made it...
say:20:1521345004:0.source_cn: 幸好有你带来芙的消息，我才能撑下去……
say:20:1521345004:0.male: You're right. If I hadn't heard about Fufu, I don't think I'd have made it...
say:20:1521345004:0.female: You're right. If I hadn't heard about Fufu, I don't think I'd have made it...

choice:3:1:2.text: You're lucky I came for you.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 多亏了我，不然后悔去吧
choice:3:1:2.male: You're lucky I came for you.
choice:3:1:2.female: You're lucky I came for you.
